answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the zenith of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The spiral holds work receipts rather than names, so the ripple of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
